dedupe_keys.name: new approaches for the design and retrofit of horizontal lateral force resisting systems

description: New Approaches for the Design and Retrofit of Horizontal Lateral Force Resisting Systems is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Matthew Eatherton, Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University (vt.edu). This project aims to advance our understanding of the vulnerabilities in the horizontal lateral force resisting system of concrete buildings subject to extreme loads and create new approaches for fiber reinforced polymer retrofit through patterns of targeted strengthening and enhanced ductility. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Diaphragms,  FRP,  Retrofit,  Seismic,  Reinforced Concrete. Published 2026-06-30. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
